title: Does PI warm-up followed by original-teacher distillation generalize?
scope: Independent replication first; causal mechanisms and cross-model/domain validation conditional

stage_1.provisional_replication_rule: For each dataset separately: mean gain >=2pp over original and positive gain in at least 2 of 3 independent warmups. Report all three; no pooled success label or confirmatory claim.
stage_1.analysis: crossed paired resampling of warmup replicates and question IDs; identical question resample across replicates/methods; generation seed bank nested in replicate; report seed-only and question-only sensitivity
stage_1.admission_rule: Measure first complete paired seed; admit remaining paired seeds only if all required evaluations and cleanup fit conservative remaining cost and time; never skip reached evaluations.

method.crossed_clusters: Resample three replicates and dataset question IDs independently with replacement; share sampled questions across all replicates and conditions. Average the eight generation draws within each question; pair seed banks across conditions.
method.interval_interpretation: Descriptive percentile uncertainty with three training replicates; no significance or generality claim; no multiplicity adjustment.
method.validation: Every endpoint question/draw set, paired generation seed, non-thinking/no-PI evaluation, data hash, and recomputed accuracy checked.

question_uncertainty.limitation: Unadjusted descriptive question-resampling intervals, conditional on one training seed and the fixed eight responses per question. They do not measure training-seed variation, establish population coverage, or correct for screening multiple recipes.

question_changes.limitation: Descriptive change in each question's correct candidate count out of eight. All four completed math OPD endpoints are included. Fixed endpoints and paired draws; not pass@8, causal evidence or replicated training-seed uncertainty.

code_timing_observations.scope: Read-only timing evidence from existing scientific runs; no new experiments. Training medians use the compact latest-20 timing rows and are not complete-run wall time. Grading durations are sandbox-worker elapsed time and exclude transport. Timers overlap; do not sum them to estimate assigned cost.

code_reliability.limitation: Descriptive fixed eight-draw counts on the same 164 questions, conditional on one training seed. Observed 8/8 is not a claim of population-perfect reliability. These counts explain the arithmetic gap between Avg@8 and pass@8, not a causal learning mechanism.

recipe_launch_verification.basis: Recorded outer launcher arguments plus matching deployed source hashes; EMA and stop flags verified.

observations.basis: Offline reanalysis of previously verified complete hosted histories; no new sampling or GPU training
observations.interpretation: PI7 worsens measured unhinted accuracy and finite original-teacher OPD4 surpasses original in these math pilots. Four is a fixed tested endpoint, not an optimized dose. No repeated cycle has been tested.

teacher_policies.fixed_original: Both PI and no-PI views use the immutable original teacher in every cycle. Carry the student forward.
teacher_policies.cycle_refresh: Both views use the detached cycle-entry student as a teacher fixed through PI and OPD; promote the post-OPD student only after the full cycle.
